description_en: Creates a data synchronization link for an RDS disaster recovery instance
description_zh: 该接口用于创建RDS灾备实例的数据同步链路
kebab_example: aliyun rds create-replication-link --db-instance-id rm-2zeytekus0r000000 --dry-run false --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateReplicationLink

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the disaster recovery instance
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run for creating the synchronization link of the disaster recovery instance. Valid values:

true: Executes a dry run without creating the instance. The system checks items such as request parameters, request format, business limits, and inventory.
false (default): Sends a normal request and creates the instance after the check is passed
parameters.help_zh:
是否对本次创建灾备实例同步链路的操作执行预检查，取值：

true：执行预检查操作，不创建实例。检查项目包含请求参数、请求格式、业务限制和库存等。
false（默认）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接创建实例
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The endpoint of the PostgreSQL source instance or the IP address of the SQL Server source instance
parameters.help_zh: PostgreSQL源实例连接地址/SQL Server源实例IP地址
parameters.name: source_address

parameters.help_en: The port of the source instance
parameters.name: source_port

parameters.help_en: The database account used for data synchronization
parameters.help_zh: 同步数据的数据库账号
parameters.name: replicator_account

parameters.help_en: The password of the synchronization account
parameters.name: replicator_password

parameters.help_en: The ID of a successful dry run task
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en:
The category of the source instance. Valid values:
other: Other. (Not supported for SQL Server.)
aliyunRDS: ApsaraDB RDS instance
parameters.help_zh:
源实例的类别，取值：
other：其他。（SQL Server不支持）
aliyunRDS：阿里云RDS实例
parameters.name: source_category

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the source instance. This parameter is required when SourceCategory is set to aliyunRDS
parameters.help_zh: 源实例地域ID，SourceCategory取值为aliyunRDS时必须指定
parameters.name: source_instance_region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the source instance. This parameter is required when SourceCategory is set to aliyunRDS
parameters.help_zh: 源实例名称，SourceCategory为aliyunRDS时必须指定
parameters.name: source_instance_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the dry run task. You can specify a custom name. If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically generates a name
parameters.help_zh: 预检查任务名称。自定义，未设置时系统自动生成
parameters.name: task_name

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the SQL Server disaster recovery instance
parameters.name: target_address

DBInstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the disaster recovery instance
